conclusion: Shared configuration and data flow work. Quality does not justify promotion: both shared variants worsen median labelled point error, and shared UFM visibly regresses during dowel rotation.
accuracy_note: Point error compares the same fixed initial reference points transformed by estimated vs labelled pose. Own demos have no independent ground-truth pose. Availability is not accuracy.
timing_note: shared_matching_ms includes one image match plus shared seeding/depth processing for all objects/groups; excludes surface fitting and is not total tracker FPS.
limitations: Three complete clips, not the full corpus.
Changing to one scene-wide pass also changes image scale/crops and point sampling; need separate ablations before attributing regression to a model.
